name: ExertPro Custom Login
author: exertpro

sections.description:
ExertPro Custom Login is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you customize the WordPress login page to match your brand identity.

Features

  • Upload a custom login page logo
  • Add a background image with brightness control
  • Set primary and secondary brand colors
  • Simple settings page inside WordPress dashboard
  • Lightweight with no external dependencies

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to “Login Option” in your WordPress dashboard menu
  3. Upload your logo URL and background image URL
  4. Choose your primary and secondary colors
  5. Set background brightness (between 0.1 and 0.9)
  6. Click Save Changes and visit your login page
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ExertPro Custom Login”
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins menu and click Activate
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, ExertPro Custom Login is completely free to use.

Where do I find the settings?

After activation, go to your WordPress dashboard and click “Login Option” in the left menu.

What image format should I use for the logo?

Any standard web image format works — PNG, JPG, or SVG. Paste the direct image URL in the logo field.
